breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: Dirichlet (u=0 at x=0 and x=1) and periodic. The ground truth resolved this by removing the periodic condition. The generated specification correctly identified and fixed this by only including the Dirichlet conditions: 'The boundary condition at x=0 is u=0.' and 'The boundary condition at x=1 is u=0.', completely omitting the incorrect periodic condition.
